sample_data.method: typed manually into the form, and separately loaded in an automated test file (src/lib/scheduler.test.ts)
sample_data.reset_instructions: Refresh the page. All data is held in React state for the session only; there is no persistence to clear.

problem_solving_method: Read the problem twice, wrote the 4 requirements and a data model in plain language before coding, then built a scheduler that places grid-power jobs first into cut-free windows (since only grid jobs have a hard timing constraint), then fills remaining time with generator/none jobs. Verified against all 25 published sample cases with an automated test checking no overlaps, no grid job inside a cut, and correct generator-minute totals.

R1.evidence: Timeline component + power-cut input, top of the page

R2.evidence: JobForm component - add jobs with name, duration, power type

R3.evidence: src/lib/scheduler.ts - scheduleJobs(), verified against 25 public cases in scheduler.test.ts

R4.evidence: totalGeneratorMinutes shown live in App.tsx, recalculated via useMemo

team_members.major_contribution: Full implementation of P01: scheduling algorithm, all UI components, automated test suite, deployment

major_design_decisions: No backend or database used - the problem only needs session-level state, so adding Supabase would add unnecessary complexity
Grid jobs scheduled before generator/none jobs, since only grid jobs have a hard constraint (avoiding power cuts)
known_limitations: Jobs are placed first-fit in the order added, not optimized for minimal generator usage
Shop open/close times are hardcoded, not yet user-editable in the UI

ai_tools_used.used_for: Designing the scheduling algorithm, writing React components, debugging TypeScript/build configuration errors, writing the automated test suite against published sample cases
ai_tools_used.how_output_was_verified: Every code chunk was read and understood before acceptance; the scheduler was independently verified by running automated tests against all 25 published fixture cases, confirming no invalid overlaps and correct generator-minute totals

declaration: The information above is complete and truthful to the best of the team's knowledge.
